subject: storytime
title: The Day You Begin words
about: On the first day in a new class, a child looks around a room where no one seems quite like her, and finds that telling her own story is the way friendships begin. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, then talk about a day he felt new somewhere.

book.author: Jacqueline Woodson
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A warm picture book about feeling different in a new place and finding the courage to share who you are.
